summary_short.zh: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。

summaries.en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

summary_short.zh: caveman项目是一个针对Claude Code的提示工程技巧，通过模仿原始人说话方式（如用'few token'代替'few tokens'）大幅削减token用量，解决大模型交互中token消耗过高的问题。核心原理是利用语言模型对精简表达的理解能力，去除冗余词汇后仍能保持输出质量，减少65%的token，证明并非所有任务都需要详细提示。作为Claude Code的自定义技能使用，适用于代码生成、快速摘要等场景，能有效降低API费用或响应延迟，是一个既有趣又实用的效率实验。

summaries.en: The caveman project is a minimalist prompt strategy for Claude Code that cuts token usage by 65% using caveman-like speech, addressing high LLM costs. It works by stripping unnecessary words while maintaining output quality, showing that many prompts are overengineered. Apply it as a custom skill for code generation or quick answers to reduce API bills or latency—a simple, practical experiment in prompt efficiency.

summary_short.zh: openclaude 是一个基于 TypeScript 的命令行 AI 代理，目标是“随处运行、随物可接”。它通过统一的终端接口，将不同模型、API 和工具组合在一起，降低多 AI 助手带来的割裂感。其最大特点是与具体供应商解耦，可灵活替换后端，并借助扩展机制融入现有开发流程。适合用于自动化复杂任务、在持续集成中调度智能体，或作为原型工具快速对比不同模型效果。你也可以把它当作脚手架，改造出贴合自己业务场景的专属 CLI 智能工具，从而更自主地控制数据流向与执行逻辑。

summaries.en: openclaude is a TypeScript-based command-line AI agent designed to run across any environment and work with virtually any model, API, or tool. It solves the fragmentation of AI assistants by offering a single, portable interface for coding and automation tasks. Its key strength lies in provider-agnostic design, letting users switch backends and extend functionality through integrations. Typical uses include orchestrating AI workflows, building developer tooling, and testing models in CI/CD. Developers can adopt it as a drop-in agent or customize it for domain-specific command-line applications.

summaries.en: OpenCode is an open-source coding agent that automates software development tasks by understanding natural language instructions and generating functional code. It leverages large language models with specialized fine-tuning for programming contexts, enabling it to handle complex coding workflows while maintaining code quality. Developers can integrate it into their IDEs to automate repetitive coding tasks, generate boilerplate code, or assist in debugging, making it practical for accelerating development cycles and exploring AI-assisted programming techniques.

summaries.en: OpenCode is an open-source coding agent that automates software development tasks by understanding natural language instructions and generating functional code. It leverages large language models with specialized fine-tuning for programming contexts, enabling it to handle complex coding workflows while maintaining code quality. Developers can integrate it into their IDEs to automate repetitive coding tasks, generate boilerplate code, or assist in debugging, making it practical for accelerating development cycles and exploring AI-assisted programming techniques.
summaries.zh: OpenCode 是一个开源编码代理，通过理解自然语言指令自动生成可运行代码，帮助开发者自动化编程任务。其核心在于针对编程场景专门微调大语言模型，使其能处理复杂开发流程并保持代码质量。用户可将其集成到开发环境中，用于自动生成重复性代码、辅助调试或探索AI编程应用，为实际开发工作提供高效支持，适合希望尝试AI辅助编程的开发者实践学习。

summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

summary_short.zh: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。

summaries.en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

summary_short.zh: 该项目将 Andrej Karpathy 关于大语言模型编程常见陷阱的观察提炼成一个 CLAUDE.md 文件，用于优化 Claude Code 的行为。它通过编码最佳实践（如避免过早优化、确保显式错误处理）充当系统提示，引导模型生成更安全、更可靠的代码。开发者只需将此文件放入项目根目录，即可立即改善 Claude 的代码生成质量。这是一个轻量级但实用的工具，适合所有使用 LLM 辅助编程的开发者，帮助他们避免常见错误，提升代码质量。

summaries.en: This project distills Andrej Karpathy's insights on common LLM coding pitfalls into a single CLAUDE.md file that guides Claude Code to produce better outputs. By encoding best practices like avoiding premature optimization and ensuring explicit error handling, it acts as a system prompt for safer, more reliable code generation. Developers can drop this file into any project to instantly improve Claude's behavior, making it a practical tool for anyone using LLM-assisted coding.

summary_short.zh: Markitdown 是一个 Python 工具，能够将 PDF 和 Office 文档等多种文件格式转换为清晰的 Markdown 文本，解决了从专有格式中提取结构化内容的难题。它通过 AI 模型智能解析文档布局，在转换过程中保留标题、列表等关键格式元素，确保输出内容的可读性和可用性。你可以将其集成到文档处理流程中，用于转换研究报告进行文本分析，或扩展自定义解析器来处理特定类型的专业文档，非常适合需要批量处理办公文档的开发者和研究人员。

summaries.en: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats like PDFs and Office documents into clean Markdown, solving the problem of extracting structured text from proprietary formats for easier editing and processing. It leverages AI models to intelligently parse document layouts and preserve formatting elements like headings and lists during conversion. You can integrate it into document processing pipelines, use it to convert research papers for analysis, or extend it with custom parsers for specialized document types.

summary_short.zh: Hyperframes 是一款 TypeScript 编写的开源框架，专为 AI 代理设计，核心理念是“编写 HTML，渲染视频”。它通过 Puppeteer 在浏览器中逐帧捕获 HTML/CSS 动画（如配合 GSAP 的复杂动效），再交给 FFmpeg 编码成视频，解决网页动画到视频文件的转化问题。其独特之处是支持 MCP 接入，使 AI 模型可直接驱动生成流程。实际使用中可将每个镜头写成 HTML 模板，由代理组织内容，自动生成产品演示、动态信息图等，让视频制作可编程、可自动化。

summaries.en: Hyperframes is an open-source TypeScript framework that turns HTML animations into videos, purpose-built for AI agents. It bridges web animation and video production by rendering HTML/CSS (including libraries like GSAP) through Puppeteer, then encoding frames with FFmpeg. Its MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets language models directly control the rendering pipeline. You can craft video scenes as HTML templates and let an agent assemble dynamic presentations, product demos, or motion graphics—making programmatic video generation accessible and scriptable.
